description: This file manages configuration settings for a backend service, including environment variable loading, default values, and data structures to hold settings related to server operation, directories, and optional features like LLM and speech-to-text providers.
external_files: dotenv (Python package for loading environment variables from a file)

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Dataclass that stores all configuration options for the backend service, including server parameters, directory paths, provider API keys, and feature toggles.
